news.title: As Trump turns 80, who are the oldest – and youngest – current world leaders?
news.summary_en: As Trump turns 80, only 16 of 186 national leaders are older. The median leader age is 63, while Nepal’s 36-year-old PM is the youngest.

news.title: Israelis, Palestinians, Americans See War in Iran Differently
news.summary_en: Three-quarters of Israelis say the U.S. made the right decision in attacking Iran, while eight-in-ten Palestinians say the opposite. Americans are more divided.

news.title: About 1 in 5 Americans have used crypto; Republicans’ use has ticked up
news.summary_en: Some of the biggest demographic differences in cryptocurrency use are by gender, age and income.
